extraction_notes: The deck's substantive content is raster. Every slide carries a full-bleed bitmap (2046x832, one per slide, distinct) that holds the slide body, plus one 971x301 logo bitmap reused on all 22 pages. Text extraction recovered only the overlay on each slide: a kicker line, a title and a one-line tagline (54-91 characters per slide). This was confirmed against the PDF image list, not inferred.

All 21 image-only regions on slides 2-22 are declared in unavailable_content. No image content was transcribed, described or inferred, and no concept below claims to cover the unreadable part of its slide.
Every concept is marked availability: partial for that reason: the readable text on its slide is the title and tagline only.

Slide 1 (title slide) yielded no concept. Its image is a decorative title scene. Slide 2 ('THE HOOK') is a section divider and slide 22 ('NEXT UP') is a next-up slide, so per the skill's decoration rule they yield no concept even though their images are declared as gaps. Slide 21 is the recap slide; its seven recap ideas live inside its image, so nothing was recoverable for it.

The source manifest reports processedSlides 22 and unavailableSlides 0 because its pipeline counted only the text layer. This document additionally declares the image-only regions; no individual slide was wholly textless, so source.unavailable_slides is empty while unavailable_content lists the lost regions.
Topic labels come from the source's own kicker lines. The subtopic labels are inferred: the source supplies no sub-headings beneath the kickers.

Source defect: slide 11 carries two private-use codepoints where ligature glyphs belong - U+E009 in the title ('one pa<U+E009>ern') and U+E007 in the tagline ('di<U+E007>erent'). The intended characters are not recoverable from the text layer. The title is reproduced verbatim in key_concept, the quote reproduces U+E007 verbatim, and the concept is marked confidence: medium rather than reconstructed.

Source defect: slide 18's tagline also contains U+E007 (in 'o<U+E007>ers'). Its quote was taken from the intact opening fragment 'Host, client, server' so the damaged word is not reproduced, and the concept is marked confidence: medium because the fourth component in that line is unreadable.
No examples anywhere: the supplied text layer contains no worked examples, demos or sample outputs. examples is [] on every concept rather than manufactured.
Slide numbering is the source's own, 1-based, from the slide-NN.md files and the manifest's slide index. No renumbering was done.
